add_definitions(
    -DCOM_NO_WINDOWS_H)

spec2def(query.dll query.spec)

# query.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/query-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(query_shims OBJECT query_main.c)
target_link_libraries(query_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(query_shims)
add_cargo_module(query query-cargo query.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS query_shims psdk)
